Let me use modular arithmetic to break this down systematically.

print(f"\nVerification:")

EOF"}}

# Let me break down 34462116119303 into parts

part2 = 116119303

# Find 10^9 mod 650
power_10_9 = pow(10, 9, 650)
print(f"10^9 mod 650 = {power_10_9}")

part1_mod = part1 % 650
print(f"34462 mod 650 = {part1_mod}")

part2_mod = part2 % 650
print(f"116119303 mod 650 = {part2_mod}")

total = (part1_mod * power_10_9 + part2_mod) % 650
print(f"(34462 × 10^9 + 116119303) mod 650 = {total}")

print("\nMethod 2: Alternative breakdown")
# 34462116119303 = 34462116 × 10^6 + 119303
part_a = 34462116
part_b = 119303

power_10_6 = pow(10, 6, 650)
print(f"10^6 mod 650 = {power_10_6}")

part_a_mod = part_a % 650
print(f"34462116 mod 650 = {part_a_mod}")

part_b_mod = part_b % 650
print(f"119303 mod 650 = {part_b_mod}")

total2 = (part_a_mod * power_10_6 + part_b_mod) % 650

print(f"\nFinal Answer: {34462116119303 % 650}")
EOF"}}
